content:
[L] high | bottom "Graph nodes" section | table is clipped at the window bottom edge — header row "KIND / LABEL / ENTITY / CREATED" is cut off mid-row with no visible rows or scrollbar
[L] high | customer effort table | "escalated" column contains two values ("1" and "—") side-by-side in one cell, colliding/overlapping as if two widgets occupy the same cell
[S] high | whole page | right half of the window (below "Health facts" area) is a large dead zone — Health facts and QA cards occupy only ~30% width while right side is empty white space
[C] high | insights page overall | content ends abruptly at a hard cutoff mid-table; no pagination, footer, or affordance indicating more content — reads like a debug dump
[S] med | top-right filter bar | range pills "1 year / 90 days / 30 days / 7 days" have uneven gaps between them and inconsistent vertical alignment with the "Sync now" button
[S] med | KPI stat cards row | card widths are unequal and gaps between "avg first response" and "resolution rate" cards differ from earlier gaps; "resolution rate" card border visibly cut/overlaps card edge
[S] med | customer effort table | table stretches full card width but columns have huge uneven gaps — conversation column has no conversation IDs shown, values float detached from their headers
[H] med | all section headers | "Health facts", "Post-resolution QA effectiveness", "Customer effort", "Graph nodes" all same size/weight as nav items — no clear page-title vs card-title hierarchy
[H] med | table cells | numeric values (2, 7.50, 12, 48.0 h) not right-aligned under their headers, breaking label/value pairing
[H] low | subtitle texts | lowercase, uncapitalized subtitles ("local analytics over the selected range", "scores persist per conversation...") lack hierarchy and read like comments
[H] low | all-caps table headers | CONVERSATION / EFFORT / MESSAGES / REOPENS headers in tiny letter-spaced caps are barely legible at this size
[C] med | KPI cards | em-dash "—" placeholder for avg first response and avg QA score shown with no "no data" state, ambiguous with the collided "—" in escalated column
[C] low | insights tab | "Insights" nav item shows a hover cursor artifact with strikethrough-style line under text — inconsistent with other inactive tabs
[S] low | "Add node" form row | inline labels and input widths inconsistent (Label, Entity id, Properties JSON have different widths with uneven spacing), reads as raw debug form

VERDICT: unprofessional — clipped tables, colliding cell values, half-empty layout, and debug-style forms place this far below Linear/Zendesk standards.
